name: BIKE_PATH_CLOSED_WHITE_SQUARE
notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. Sheet TM8-SA110A (black on white): BIKEWAY 100 C over CLOSED 100 C; the sheet gives the alternative first line BIKE PATH 100 B, 470 wide (TM8-SA110A_BIKE_PATH). Layout: 600 x 600, white, R0, black border 25, no edge strip. Legend placed from the sheet's own filled artwork measured at 1200 dpi (letter heights from the ink, series confirmed by the FHWA widths, each word centred on its ink; the sheet's dimension chains were not transcribed one by one for this sign — the positions are the sheet's drawn artwork itself, which the overlay check confirms): BIKEWAY 100 C top 150 x 75-533 (458); CLOSED 100 D top 350 x 55-539 (484). This spec is the sheet's alternative legend: BIKE PATH 100 B, 470 overall (90 / 470 / 90 — drawn above the sign on the sheet), in place of BIKEWAY at the same height.
